purpose: Exploratory fixed confidence residual trained from user-authorized Engauge development positives and authenticated synthetic family training proposals.

training_inputs.real: Study-partitioned train groups only, exact-image grouped, production pre-marker masks and proposal preprocessing. Labeled centers within three pixels provide positive supervision only; unmarked real pixels are not negative labels.
training_inputs.synthetic: 9053 family train rows with four fixed reflections; binary labels and raster patches are bound to the retained V37 family training evidence.

architecture: Freeze the verified V37 local marker model and geometry; add a zero-initialized confidence residual on its spatial features.
training_device: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT gfx1032 via HIP cuda:0; CPU optimizer steps forbidden
recipe: Eight fixed epochs, synthetic batch 128, real-positive batch 16, positive-only real weight 0.25, AdamW learning rate 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, seed 20261002, fixed threshold 0.1; 2264 optimizer steps.
evaluation: Evaluate the single final checkpoint against the fixed synthetic family and component development gates and record the limitations of their source overlap and mask provenance. Evaluate user-authorized held-out development studies separately. No threshold search, checkpoint selection, private sealed evaluation, production activation or release is authorized by this trial.
